tooltip.devil_bone_gambler.devils_dice: Devil's Dice: right click to roll, and the point and colour decide the result
tooltip.devil_bone_gambler.devils_dice_r: Right clicking inside an altar range opens the offering screen instead
tooltip.devil_bone_gambler.devils_dice_s: Sneak while holding it to see the altars around you through walls
tooltip.devil_bone_gambler.dice_place: Hold the placement key (Tab by default) and right click to set the die down, and break it with the key held to take it back
tooltip.devil_bone_gambler.gamblers_dice: Gambler's Dice: right click to roll, and the point and colour decide the result
With another player nearby, sneaking and right clicking starts a wager instead
Sneak while holding it to see the dealers around you through walls
A wager member cannot use gambler dice until the wager ends or they leave
tooltip.devil_bone_gambler.devils_altar: Devil's Altar: offerings inside its range raise its level and range
tooltip.devil_bone_gambler.devils_altar_: It can also be worn on the head, which counts as placing an altar where the wearer stands
tooltip.devil_bone_gambler.offering_valu: Offering Value Table: right click to read the offering value of items and creatures
It can be searched and switched between all, items and creatures
tooltip.devil_bone_gambler.gamblers_deal: It walks and pauses on its own, and two dealers in one territory fight each other
A fallen dealer drops the gambler dice left in its bag, and a full bag drops more; a hit now and then knocks one out as well
tooltip.devil_bone_gambler.gameplay_manu: Gameplay Manual: the rules and the flow of play
A copy is handed out on every join and every respawn
tooltip.devil_bone_gambler.admin_manual: Admin Manual: the fields and actions an admin can configure
tooltip.devil_bone_gambler.admin_manual_: Admins only; a dropped copy returns after a moment, and a container copy comes back when the screen closes
tooltip.devil_bone_gambler.creator_manua: Creator Manual: the creator only actions and rules
Creator only; a dropped copy returns after a moment, and a container copy comes back when the screen closes
